title: Restore links Transfer payees to same-named accounts of OTHER budgets (linkRestoredTransferPayees lacks a.budget_id scope)
notes:
Found in the phase 5c/5d E2E (budget-ku4): in budgetnew_dev, Trabalho's 'Transfer : Poupança Nubank' and 'Transfer : Itau Conta Corrente' payees point at Casa's accounts, so creating a transfer to them answers 400 'transfer account not found in budget' (old API identical, pre-existing, same SQL as syscd). api/src/budget/store/restore.ts linkRestoredTransferPayees: UPDATE payees p SET transfer_account_id = a.id FROM accounts a WHERE p.budget_id = $1 AND p.name = 'Transfer : ' || a.name -- missing AND a.budget_id = $1 (and NOT a.deleted). Needs a fix + a data repair for rows already cross-linked.
Fixed in 5b17747 (restore.ts link scoped by a.budget_id + NOT a.deleted); tests in api/src/budget/routes/transfer-payee-scope.test.ts; owner repair in docs/runbooks/transfer-payee-cross-budget.md (not run). Merged to main, not pushed. 842 tests pass.
Done in the new API only: restore links transfer payees with p.budget_id = $1 AND a.budget_id = $1 (api/src/budget/store/restore.ts), commit 5b17747 on main, released in 2026.11.18-01. Existing bad rows in the shared DB and the same bug in syscd-app are not fixed: see docs/runbooks/transfer-payee-cross-budget.md (not run) and docs/MORNING.md.
